verdict.rationale: Greptile automatically reviews every pull request, and users can configure review triggers, PR filters and file patterns through the dashboard or a repo-level greptile.json. That means users can set rules for when the review action fires on PR events. Beyond that, the automation is fixed: custom rules shape review content rather than triggering arbitrary actions, and model routing for agent-authored PRs is built-in behavior, not user-defined. Missing for 10: a general user-defined event→action rule engine (e.g., custom actions, webhooks or chained workflows on arbitrary events), detailed trigger documentation, and independent corroboration of trigger configuration.
